scope: Scheduler worker connection lifecycle and retry after transient database failure
verified: Each scheduler tick obtains a fresh PostgreSQL connection with a five-second connect timeout.
The worker identity remains stable across tick connections.
Tick failures discard the connection without attempting rollback on the potentially broken session.
A later tick can connect and complete after an earlier connection or tick failure.
limitations: A separate disposable runtime check confirmed PostgreSQL stop/start reconnection with a stubbed scheduler engine; actual scheduler SQL and lease recovery were not exercised.
Provider delivery and long-duration outage acceptance remain open.
Candidate and legacy databases were not accessed.
